name: Default
shortDescription: Low-code platform for building internal tools, admin panels and dashboards on top of databases and APIs, in the all-in-one Community Edition image.

alerts.message: The first account created in the web UI becomes the instance administrator. Open the app right after deployment and register it; the first start can take up to 5 minutes.
This image runs MongoDB, Redis and PostgreSQL inside the Appsmith container. Upstream recommends at least 8 GB of RAM on the server for this all-in-one setup.
